parameters.query:
INSERT INTO candidates (job_id, name, full_name, applied_position, email, cv_content, match_score, approval_status, status, ai_evaluation)
VALUES (
  COALESCE((SELECT id FROM jobs WHERE id = {{ Number($json.job_id) || 1 }} LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM jobs ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1), 1),
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.candidate_name) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.candidate_name) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.position || 'Chuyên viên Marketing') }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.candidate_email) }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.cv_text) }},
  {{ Number($json.match_score) || 0 }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.status) }},
  {{ $json.status === 'APPROVED' ? "'Đạt'" : "'Loại'" }},
  {{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_evaluation) }}
);
